_comment: Lessons name voice SLOTS (male_1, male_2, female_1, female_2). A profile maps slots to real voices. Switch TTS provider by building with another profile; cache keys change only for lines whose voice changed. Voice names checked on official docs 3 Nov 2026 (Azure hi-IN list; Indic Parler-TTS card).

female_2.label: Priyamvada (higher)
female_2.note: Demo only: the one Piper Hindi female voice, pitch-shifted so two women in a scene sound different.

male_1.speaker: Rohit
male_1.label: Rohit
male_1.description: Rohit speaks in a natural, friendly conversational tone at a moderate speed with moderate pitch. Very clear audio, close up, with no background noise.
male_1.verify: Model card lists Rohit and Divya as recommended Hindi speakers, Aman and Rani as available; genders are not stated. Confirm by ear in the notebook listening test.
